events.root: A reversed selection inequality independently changes the significance decision.
Wrong rounding method is independently imposed.

turn_overrides.T1: Use the raw pvalue rather than padj as the multiple-testing decision field.
turn_overrides.T2: Apply the reversed selection rule padj>0.05 rather than the executed padj<0.05 rule.
turn_overrides.T3: Round to three decimal places rather than three significant figures.

human_repair_overrides.content: Use log2FoldChange rather than padj as the multiple-testing decision field.
Apply the reversed rule that a value passes only when it is greater than 0.05.
Report the visible padj to three decimal places, giving 0.000, rather than to three significant figures.
